# Differential abundance
log2 SOMAmer RFUs compared between GCA and Not GCA adjusted for age, sex,sample log2 RFU IQR and GC days.
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
top_n_daps <- res.limma %>%
  arrange(P.Value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 40)
figs$volcano <- res.limma %>%
  mutate(
    colour = case_when(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "up",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "down",
      .default = "notSig"
    ),
    colour = factor(colour, levels = c("up", "down", "notSig")),
    label = if_else(apt_id %in% top_n_daps$apt_id, EntrezGeneSymbol, NA)
  )
figs$volcano <- figs$volcano %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = colour)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, min.segment.length = 0, bg.colour = "white", max.overlaps = Inf) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0(nrow(filter(figs$volcano, colour == "up")), " increased in GCA"),
    hjust = 1, vjust = -1, colour = "#B53737FF", size = 3.5,
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0(nrow(filter(figs$volcano, colour == "down")), " decreased in GCA"),
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = -1, colour = "#00344AFF", size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2.1, 2.1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("up" = "#B53737FF", down = "#00344AFF", notSig = "grey80")) +
  labs(x = "log<sub>2</sub>(FC)", y = "-log<sub>10</sub>(<i>P</i>)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
figs$volcano
```

# Tissue + cell enrichment
Testing tissue, cell-type and protein localisation enrichment among
differential abundant SOMAmers.
Used **TissueEnrich** so a lot of references to tissues, but essentially can
be any group e.g. cell type

Enrichment is based off the following categories:
- Not expressed: Genes with <1 TPM across all groups
- Tissue enriched: >1 TPM and >5-fold higher expression in 1 group compared to others
- Group enriched: >1 TPM and >5-fold higher expression in 2-7 groups compared to others and not tissue enriched
- Tissue enhanced: >1 TPM and have >5-fold higher expression in 1 group compared to mean expression in other groups and not group enriched
- Expressed in all: >=1 TPM across any group but not in any of above groups
- Mixed: not assigned into any of the above groups

```{r}
tissue_enrich <- readRDS(here("01_differential_abundance/data/tissueEnrichment.rds"))
cell_enrich <- readRDS(here("01_differential_abundance/data/cellEnrichment.rds"))
```

### Tissue
Making use of both HPA + GTEx
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6.5}
(figs$tissue_enrichment <- tissue_enrich$consensus$source_data %>%
  mutate(asterisk = if_else(fdr < 0.05, "*", NA)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fold.change, y = fct_reorder(tissue, fold.change, .desc = TRUE))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = -log10(fdr))) +
  geom_text(aes(label = asterisk), hjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = "Fold change", y = NULL, fill = "-log<sub>10</sub>(FDR <i>P</i>)")+
   theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.justification.inside = c(1, 0),
    legend.background = element_blank()
  ))
```

# GSEA
GSEA performed on ranked t-statistics from differential abundance analysis.
```{r}
# import
gsea_tidy <- map(c("hallmark", "reactome"), \(x) readRDS(here("01_differential_abundance/data/gsea.rds")) |>
                                              pluck(x, "gseaOutput")) |>

  set_names(c("hallmark", "reactome")) |> list_rbind(names_to = "source") |>
  mutate(nes_direction = if_else(NES > 0, "Gene set increased in GCA", "Gene set decreased in GCA"))
```



```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
figs$gsea_heatmap <- gsea_tidy %>% filter(padj < 0.05)

# get order of pathways for plotting
geneset_order <- figs$gsea_heatmap %>%
  arrange(desc(NES)) |>
  arrange(source) |>
  pull(pathway)

(figs$gsea_heatmap <- map(c("Gene set increased in GCA", "Gene set decreased in GCA"), \(x) figs$gsea_heatmap %>%
  filter(nes_direction == x) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "x", y = factor(pathway, levels = geneset_order))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = NES)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#90005D", mid = "#F4FAF0", high = "#315D00",
    limits = c(min(figs$gsea_heatmap$NES), max(figs$gsea_heatmap$NES)),
    guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), limits = rev, labels = scales::wrap_format(40)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  figTheme("box") +
    facet_grid(source~., scale="free_y", space="free") +
  theme(
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )))
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
gsea_somamers <- readRDS(here("01_differential_abundance/data/somamers_used_gsea.rds"))
gseaHeatmaps <- function() {
  df <- gsea_tidy |>
    filter(padj < 0.05) |>
    unnest(leadingEdge) |>
    select(source, pathway, EntrezGeneID = leadingEdge, NES) |>
    left_join(res.limma, by = "EntrezGeneID", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    filter(
      apt_id %in% gsea_somamers$apt_id,
      adj.P.Val < 0.05
    ) |>
    mutate(direction = case_when(
      NES > 0 ~ "Proteins increased in GCA",
      NES < 0 ~ "Proteins reduced in GCA"
    ))

  dirs <- unique(df$direction)

  imap(c("Proteins increased in GCA", "Proteins reduced in GCA"), \(x, i) {
    direction_df <- df |> filter(direction == x)

    protein_in_gs <- map(unique(direction_df$pathway), \(pw) {
      direction_df |>
        distinct(EntrezGeneSymbol) |>
        mutate(
          in_gs = if_else(
            EntrezGeneSymbol %in% filter(direction_df, pathway == pw)$EntrezGeneSymbol,
            "Yes", "No"
          ),
          pathway = pw
        )
    }) |> list_rbind()


    protein_order <- protein_in_gs |>
      count(in_gs, EntrezGeneSymbol) |>
      filter(in_gs == "Yes") |>
      arrange(desc(n)) |>
      pull(EntrezGeneSymbol) |>
      unique()



    p_logfc <- direction_df |>
      distinct(apt_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      mutate(EntrezGeneSymbol = factor(EntrezGeneSymbol, levels = protein_order)) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = EntrezGeneSymbol, y = "GCA diagnosis<br>log<sub>2</sub>(FC)")) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = logFC), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), guide = guide_axis(angle = 45), position = "top") +
      scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), position = "right") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#00344aff", mid = "#f5f5f5ff", high = "#b53737ff",
                           limits = c(min(df$logFC), max(df$logFC)),
                           guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black")) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "log<sub>2</sub>(FC)") +
      figTheme("box") +
      theme(axis.text.y.right = ggtext::element_markdown(size=10))


    p_gsea <- direction_df |>
      select(pathway, NES, source) |>
      distinct() |>
      mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = geneset_order)) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = "x", y = pathway)) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = NES), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), limits = rev, labels = scales::wrap_format(50)) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#90005D", mid = "#F4FAF0", high = "#315D00",
                           limits = c(min(df$NES), max(df$NES)),
                           guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black")) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      facet_grid(factor(source,
                        levels = c("hallmark", "reactome"),
                        labels = c("hallmark"="Hallmark", "reactome"="Reactome"))~.,
                 scale="free_y", space="free",switch = "y") +
      figTheme("box") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),axis.text.y=element_text(size=8),
            strip.placement = "outside",strip.clip = "off")


    p_in_gs <- protein_in_gs |>
      mutate(
        pathway = factor(pathway, levels = geneset_order),
        EntrezGeneSymbol = factor(EntrezGeneSymbol, levels = protein_order)
      ) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = EntrezGeneSymbol, y = pathway)) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = in_gs), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), guide = guide_axis(angle = 45), position = "top") +
      scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), limits = rev) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "grey25", "No" = "white"), na.value = NA) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Protein in gene set") +
      figTheme("box") +
      theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

    top_panel_height <- c(1, 10)

    p <- ((plot_spacer() / p_gsea + plot_layout(heights = top_panel_height)) |
            (p_logfc / p_in_gs + plot_layout(heights = top_panel_height))) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(1, 15), heights = c(1, 10), guides = "collect") +
      plot_annotation(subtitle = x)

    # remove legends from first group only
    if (i == 1) p <- p & theme(legend.position = "none")
    if (i != 1) p <- p & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

    p
  })
}
(figs$gsea_heatmaps <- wrap_plots(gseaHeatmaps(), ncol=1))
```

gsea_tidy |> write_csv(here("supp_data/gsea.csv"))

# Comparison with published Olink results
Using TAB+ cGCA vs Not cGCA from Rob's paper.
Olink analysis uses as superset of the SomaScan samples.

First check sample overlap
```{r}
olink_sample_ids <- read_csv(here("raw_data/TABUL_Olink/Cohort2_Post_QC_Batch-AdjustedZ-scores.csv")) |>
  #drop first column (row numbers)
  select(-1) |>
  select(study_id=S_ID)

table(meta$study_id %in% olink_sample_ids$study_id)
```


```{r}
# olink sum stats
olink_gca <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("raw_data/lvv_olink/MaughanEtAl2025_supp.xlsx"), sheet = 14, skip = 2) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()
```


### Overlap of protein between Olink and SomaScan panels

Rerun SomaScan GCA associations - followed method in Rob's paper. lm(protein ~ ref_dx)
```{r}
soma_olink <- readRDS(here("01_differential_abundance/data/lvv_olink_soma_replication_lm.rds")) |>
  left_join(olink_gca,by="ensembl_id", suffix = c(".soma", ".olink")) |>
  mutate(adj_pval.olink=p.adjust(pval.olink,method="fdr"),
         platform_sig = case_when(adj_pval.soma < 0.05 & adj_pval.olink<0.05 ~ "Both",
                                  adj_pval.soma < 0.05 & adj_pval.olink > 0.05 ~ "SomaScan",
                                  adj_pval.soma > 0.05 & adj_pval.olink <0.05 ~ "Olink",
                                  adj_pval.soma > 0.05 & adj_pval.olink > 0.05 ~ "None"))
```

How many SOMAmers target the overlapping proteins?
```{r}
length(unique(soma_olink$apt_id))
```

## Effect size correlation
```{r}
(figs$olink_comparison <- ggplot(soma_olink, aes(x = log2fc.soma, y = log2fc.olink)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = platform_sig)) +
  geom_richtext(
    data = tidy(cor.test(~ log2fc.soma + log2fc.olink, data = soma_olink, method = "pearson")),
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0(
      "<i>r</i> = ", round(estimate, 2), "<br>",
      formatPvalLabel(p.value), "<br>",
      "Common proteins = ", length(unique(soma_olink$UniProt))
    )),
    size = 3.5, fill = NA, label.color = NA, vjust = 1, hjust = 0
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(data = soma_olink %>% filter(platform_sig == "Both"), aes(label = EntrezGeneSymbol), max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, bg.colour = "white", size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Both" = "#009E73", "SomaScan" = "#E69F00",
    "Olink" = "#56B4E9", "None" = "grey"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "log<sub>2</sub>(FC) SomaScan", y = "log<sub>2</sub>(FC) Olink",
    colour = "FDR <i>P</i> < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top", legend.title = element_markdown(hjust=0.5)))

```

Restrict to proteins sig associated (FDR < 0.05) in both platform comparisons
```{r}
soma_olink_sig_both <- soma_olink |> filter(platform_sig=="Both")
datatable(soma_olink_sig_both)

# N somamer
nrow(soma_olink_sig_both)

# n proteins (uniprot)
length(unique(soma_olink_sig_both$UniProt))
```
Proteins up + down
```{r}
#up
unique(filter(soma_olink_sig_both,log2fc.soma>0)$EntrezGeneSymbol)
#down
unique(filter(soma_olink_sig_both,log2fc.soma<0)$EntrezGeneSymbol)
```

Plot
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
(figs$olink_comparison_sig_both <- ggplot(soma_olink_sig_both,aes(x=log2fc.soma, y=log2fc.olink)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point(colour = "#009E73") +
  geom_richtext(
    data = tidy(cor.test(~ log2fc.soma + log2fc.olink, data = soma_olink_sig_both, method = "pearson")),
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0(
      "<i>r</i> = ", round(estimate, 2), "<br>",
      formatPvalLabel(p.value), "<br>")),
    size = 3.5, fill = NA, label.color = NA, vjust = 1, hjust = 0
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = EntrezGeneSymbol), max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, bg.colour = "white", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "log<sub>2</sub>(FC) SomaScan", y = "log<sub>2</sub>(FC) Olink"))
ggsave(here("figures/annotated/supp_soma_olink_sig.png"), height = 4, width = 5, dpi=600, device=agg_png)
```
